conversation.q: How can you help me analyze my parking facilities?
a: I read every facility live: occupancy, revenue, traffic, turnover, rates and incidents.
Ask in plain language and I compare your sites, flag anomalies and tell you what to change.

conversation.q: Show me an overview of all my parking facilities.
a: 12 sites online. Occupancy 68%, revenue today $41,280, 3 sites at capacity.
Tour CIBC and Central Plateau run 9 points above last month. One site is under-priced in the evening.
Peak arrivals 8:30–9:15 AM and 5:45–6:30 PM on weekdays.
Open the south lane 10 minutes earlier, extend the evening cap to 8 PM and move the 6 PM rate to $6.50.

conversation.q: Which parking earned the most this month?
a: Tour CIBC leads with $128,400, up 14% month over month.
Central Plateau follows at $96,100. The gap comes from weekday evening demand.

conversation.q: Schedule a new rate starting at 4 PM
a: Done. The $7.00 evening rate applies today from 4 PM at all 12 sites, fixed contracts aside.
Want me to preview the revenue impact before it goes live?

conversation.q: Automate a monthly revenue and occupancy report.
a: Set up. On the 1st of each month at 7 AM, I send a PDF and a spreadsheet with revenue, occupancy, average ticket and rate changes per site.
Should I copy your finance team?

conversation.q: Forecast occupancy and traffic for the next 7 days.
a: Average occupancy 71%, peaking Friday 6–8 PM at 94%.
Rain on Wednesday will shift arrivals 20 minutes earlier. Hold the current rate until Thursday.

conversation.q: Suggest dynamic pricing structures across all my sites.
a: Three fit your data: a base rate with a demand multiplier for offices, event surge pricing near arenas, and a flat weekend cap for retail.
Applied as-is, the model projects +11% revenue and +4 points of occupancy.

actions.action: Confirms the loop and the camera view, opens the barrier if your rules allow it, then flags the site for your team.

actions.situation: The visitor can't explain the problem
actions.action: Asks again in the same language, keeps the line, then hands the call to your queue with what it learned.

teams.title: Our team *or your team.*
teams.lead: ParkAid answers with your agents, with ours, or with both. Your intercoms and help lines arrive in one queue, so a call is picked up by whoever is available: your staff on shift, our agents, or the AI assistant while everyone is busy.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information we collect on this website, why we collect it, who it is shared with and how you can exercise your rights. It follows the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Quebec) and the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (Canada).

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: This website is operated by Logiciel Parkwize Inc. (“Parkwize”, “we”), a company incorporated in Quebec, Quebec enterprise number (NEQ) 1181843559.
Head office: 700-2828 boulevard Laurier, Québec (Québec) G1V 0B9, Canada.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This policy covers the marketing website parkwize.ai and the forms on it. The Parkwize platform used by our clients (app.parkwize.ai) is governed by the agreement signed with each client and by its own privacy terms.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We only collect what you choose to send us and the minimum needed to run the website:
items: Demo request form: first and last name, work email, company, job title, country, information about your parking facilities, the products that interest you and your message.
Contact form: first and last name, email, company (optional), topic and message.
Audience statistics: anonymous, aggregated page views measured without cookies (Vercel Web Analytics). No profile is built and you are not identified.
Technical logs: our host automatically records technical data such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, for security and to keep the site running.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information only to answer your request, prepare and hold your demo, follow up with you about it, and protect and improve the website.
We do not sell or rent your personal information, and we do not add you to a marketing list without your consent.

sections.title: Consent
paragraphs: Before sending a form, you agree to be contacted about your request by checking the consent box. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us through the contact form; we will then stop contacting you and delete your information, unless the law requires us to keep it.

sections.title: Service providers and transfers outside Quebec
paragraphs: We rely on a small number of providers who process information on our behalf, under contracts that require them to protect it and use it only for the services they provide to us:
items: Vercel Inc. (United States): website hosting and cookieless audience statistics.
Resend (United States): delivery of form submissions to our team by email.
sections.note: Your information may therefore be stored or processed outside Quebec and Canada. Before any such transfer, we assess whether the information will be adequately protected, as required by Quebec law.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep form submissions as long as needed to handle your request and the business relationship that follows, and no longer than three years after our last exchange. The information is then deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The website is served only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and access to submissions is limited to the people who need it to answer you. If a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious injury, we will notify the people concerned and the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec, as the law requires.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies, and it does not store information in your browser. Our audience statistics are measured without cookies. If this changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to the law, you can:
items: access the personal information we hold about you and obtain a copy;
have it corrected if it is inaccurate, incomplete or ambiguous;
withdraw your consent and have it deleted;
ask that it be communicated to you or to another organization in a structured, commonly used technological format;
file a complaint with the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec if you are not satisfied with our answer.
sections.note: To exercise these rights, write to us through the contact form. We may ask you to confirm your identity and will answer within 30 days.

sections.title: Person in charge of personal information
paragraphs: The person in charge of the protection of personal information at Logiciel Parkwize Inc. is its president. You can reach them through the contact form, by choosing any topic and mentioning “Privacy” in your message, or by mail at the address above, to the attention of the person in charge of the protection of personal information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the website or to the law. The date at the top of the page shows the latest version. Significant changes will be highlighted on this page.
